description: CabinetRows.build: groups the boxes in the cabinet into product rows under category sections. Filters (location, status of the box, then the search on the row name) apply before the row is built, so a row holds only the boxes that passed. Product key = GTIN, else the normalized name; a row is one (category, key). Row name = name of the most recently created box (then greater id). Row status = most urgent box (expired, expiringSoon, unknown, ok). Row displayName = ShortName.of(name), except that when two rows of the same section have the same short name (as normalized text) both show their full name. Rows are ordered by the normalized displayName, then by first box id: status and expiry do not move a row. Boxes: expiry (none last), createdOrder, id. Sections: categoryOrder, then other categories by key, `uncategorized` always last. Box ids `bN` become UUIDs ending in N (zero-padded) so id order is numeric; `status` is given per box (the app supplies it from the expiry-status rule); `createdOrder` is a rank, not a date; locations are opaque labels.
